children: Indian shares will open lower on Wednesday, in line with global markets, as oil prices surged to a near-six-week high after the U.S. and Iran exchanged strikes overnight, intensifying the Middle East conflict and renewing concerns over inflation.
GIFT Nifty futures (GIFc1) were at 24,033.5 points as of 7:38 a.m. IST, indicating a negative start for the Nifty 50 index

The U.S. said it had launched a series of airstrikes against targets in Iran overnight, prompting an Iranian response in a renewed escalation of tensions in the Middle East.
